answers.answer: Neither a live stream nor an existing pipeline is required for this simple reply. Sign in, select the channel and have the bot running and connected. Moderator, Lead moderator, Editor or Broadcaster can change timers by default, subject to a raised requirement; VIP read access cannot edit. A timer can post offline, so it must be switched off when a live-only reminder should stop.
quote: Sign in and select your channel. By default, a Moderator, Lead moderator, Editor or Broadcaster can change its timers and chat triggers. The broadcaster can raise the required role on Permissions.

The bot must be running and connected to the channel to check timers and receive chat. Timers can post while the stream is offline, so switch off a reminder when you finish if you only want it during broadcasts. A simple reply needs no existing command or pipeline.
The broadcaster can also grant a VIP read access to either tab independently. A VIP sees that tab’s list, without an editor.

quote: Choose Create timer. The dialog closes and the timer appears in the list, switched on.
Watch your channel’s chat for “Take a moment to stretch and get some water.” After the next 30-minute wait and an eligible timer check, the bot posts the second line.
The stream being offline does not stop a timer in a connected channel. Switch it off to stop a live-only reminder.
Saves immediately. An off timer stays listed as Off and posts nothing.

answers.answer: this is nice matches because Contains the words can match hi inside a longer word. HI matches with capitalization matching off. With the ! command prefix illustrated in the article, !hi is excluded because prefix-starting lines are not ordinary chat-trigger input, even if no valid command runs. The article does not establish the actual selected channel prefix, so that exclusion is conditional on ! being its prefix. Set How chat must match to Is exactly the words and Save changes to narrow it to a whole-line hi greeting; capitalization remains ignored unless Match capital letters is enabled.
quote: For example, hi with Contains the words also matches this. Choose Is exactly the words to answer only the greeting, or use a suitable pattern for a more specific rule.
With Match capital letters off, Hello and hello match the same way. Turning it on makes them different. An invalid regular expression is refused when you save.

Chat triggers watch ordinary chat lines. A line starting with the channel’s command prefix is excluded, even when it does not run a valid command. A line claimed by another command or by a soundboard trigger is excluded too.
Choose Save changes to keep edits, or Discard to return to the saved trigger. Saving clears the unsaved count and updates the words in the list.
